headline: Tax Burden Shifted to Owner-Occupied and Monthly-Rent Conversions, Raising Concerns Over Deepening Jeonse and Monthly Rent Shortage
summary: Speculation suggests tax reform will raise holding taxes on multi-home owners and non-resident single-home owners, and that the burden may pass to tenants. Rental supply has recently shrunk, shifting the market toward landlords.
why: Housing tax changes affect property valuations, rental supply and household costs, which feed into Korea's broader housing market and mortgage sector.
